name: Cynefin Lego Game (agile42)
description: Free (CC BY-SA 3.0 Germany) tabletop LEGO-based experiential simulation designed by agile42 to teach the Cynefin framework. Participants build LEGO structures under different constraint regimes corresponding to each Cynefin domain, directly experiencing the differences between ordered and unordered contexts.
